messages:
maria: heads up — vault audit logs for namespace 'prod-secrets' stopped around 09:12 UTC after an RBAC sweep. anyone else seeing gaps?

alice: saw that. i removed a temporary analytics binding at ~09:10 to tighten access. could be related.

jin: does that impact the pubsub -> gcs collector SA? infra had a change logged.

devops-bot: Policy change applied: analytics-sink-role REMOVED from serviceAccount:svc-collector@redwood-project. Change-ID ch-8791

maria: that's the one. the audit sink writes to gs://redwood-audit-processed and we got ACL errors. missing ~15m of vault audit events (09:12-09:28).

lee: can we rehydrate from the KMS-wrapped backups? backups live in gs://redwood-audit-backups/wrapped/*.enc if I recall.

alice: IAM fix incoming. i rolled the role change but need to confirm. also, who can unwrap with KMS?

jin: unwrap uses kms-operator SA. looks like its KMS decrypt binding was removed during the sweep too. need temporary grant.

maria: if kms-operator can't decrypt we can't import audit blobs. options: grant kube/iam decrypt, or have a human with decrypt perms run gcloud. prefer short-lived grant.

alice: i can grant cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt to kms-operator@infra for the keyring. plan: unwrap -> import -> rotate any exposed creds. ok?

lee: +1. also we should rotate secrets-fetcher token — logs show requests from an unknown IP in that window.

jin: proposed runbook:
1) alice grants kms.decrypt to kms-operator@infra
2) run unwrap job (gcloud kms decrypt) for gs://redwood-audit-backups/wrapped/2026-03-23-*.enc
3) checksum unwrapped blobs and store in gs://redwood-audit-sig for chain-of-custody
4) cat /tmp/*.json | vault audit-import -namespace=prod-secrets (dry-run first)
5) confirm event counts, then rotate any impacted service tokens (eg service/secrets-fetcher)

maria: add: capture sha256 of each plaintext file before import and save to audit-sig bucket with ACL limited to secops.

alice: granting perms now, ETA ~2m.

devops-bot: Permission change applied: kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter granted to serviceAccount:kms-operator@infra. Requestor: alice.

jin: starting unwrap job now — will paste errors/output.

vault-bot: vault import dry-run complete: 3 files failed schema check (likely truncated).

maria: which files failed? paste the errors when you have them.

jin: small output:
```
error: file 2026-03-23-09-14.json truncated: unexpected end of input
error: file 2026-03-23-09-17.json truncated: unexpected end of input
```
Looks like two wrapped blobs are truncated — maybe upload cut mid-rotation. i'll pull originals from gs://redwood-audit-raw and retry.

lee: if those events are irrecoverable mark the window for forensic review and escalate. also rotate any tokens that might appear in the partials.

alice: i fetched the raw blob for 09:14 and it indeed contains a partial service token string for secrets-fetcher. rotating now.

maria: executing rotation plan: create new token in vault, update k8s secret, roll secrets-fetcher. i'll coordinate.

jin: applied new secret and triggered rollout:
```
kubectl -n prod set secret generic secrets-fetcher-creds --from-literal=token=REDACTED_NEW
kubectl rollout restart deploy/secrets-fetcher -n prod
```

devops-bot: Deployment secrets-fetcher restarted. rollout status: in_progress

maria: note: we should also revoke the old token in vault and record the change in the incident doc.

lee: i'll own the postmortem. assigning to maria, alice, jin for action items and timeline. create incident: INC-2026-042 and add links.

alice: adding an infra ticket to add an automated check that detects audit-sink ACL drift and alerts secops.

maria: thanks — once import completes and counts verified i'll close this thread. attaching incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-2026-042

jin: import retry in progress — i'll paste final counts when done.

vault-bot: import finished (non-dry-run): 4352 events imported, 2 events dropped (truncated blobs).

maria: recorded. closing loop: old secrets-fetcher token revoked, kms-operator perms reverted, audit checks ticket created. thanks all :thumbsup:
